authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 sections 20.1, 20.2, 20.4.9 and 20.4.16–17 specify non-entity ownership, AC1015 nolinks and entity neighbor references, and compound child framing.
scope: Explicit DRW_DwgLegacyModelChainProvider for AC1015 only: a nonempty predeclared model-space ordered sequence of concrete LINE/CIRCLE/ARC with unique unreserved handles in [0x30, UINT32_MAX). The default plotstyle graph is a separate opt-in. Neighbor values are known before each entity frame and its handle occurrence receipt is emitted. Unplanned/unsupported geometry, user blocks, paper space, raw replay, invalid identities and ownership aliases fail the output; default non-opt-in behavior is unchanged.

source_evidence.finding: ODA producer places top-level geometry in the model BLOCK_RECORD chain, POLYLINE vertices and INSERT ATTRIBs in separate per-parent chains, and SEQEND in an isolated null-ended frame. Current opt-in intentionally refuses those compound forms.

oda_output.reader: ODA File Converter 27.1.0 ACAD2013 DXF; all three generated AC1015 inputs use both the explicit chain and default plotstyle providers; no .err files were produced.
oda_output.geometry: Both three-entity conversions retain LINE (1,2,3)–(4,5,6), CIRCLE center (7,8,0) radius 2.5 and ARC center (10,11,0), radius 4, start/end 0.25/1.25 radians. Singleton retains the LINE.

validation: PASS focused legacy chain, HEADER sealing and default plotstyle CTests and LibreCAD 3 compile guard. Focused suite checks exact immutable per-frame occurrence receipts, concrete types/handles/order, missing/extra/paper/compound/unplanned failures, NOD/GROUP/typed dictionary alias rejection, code-3 IMAGEDEF and code-4 XRECORD owner rejection, legitimate GROUP member pointer, unchanged destination and same-facade retries, and nested/reentrant/exception/concurrent TLS scopes. GNU LibreDWG independently verifies exact BLOCK_RECORD endpoints, soft-pointer neighbors and geometry for ascending, nonmonotonic and singleton output. A pre-change dwgBufferW header object (size 72 on this host) links and runs against the current library; installed class layout is unchanged.
limits: This bounded opt-in does not implement compounds, named blocks, paper-space chains, raw replay, general AC1015 output compatibility, native Windows/Linux qualification or broad DWG/DXF feature parity. No generated drawing fixture is committed.
